name: Monument Health VolunTEEN Program
what_you_do: Teens first do a job shadow at the hospital, then volunteer one shift a week for 10 to 12 weeks. Tasks are not listed on the program page.
who_can_apply: Teens must be 16 to 18 years of age before graduating high school. A parent must sign a consent form.
duration: One 2 to 4 hour shift a week, same day and time, for 10 to 12 weeks (at least 30 hours).
deadline_text: Sessions start in October, February and June. Applications are due by the last business day of the month before a session starts, so the February 2027 session needs an application by the end of January 2027.
how_to_apply: Submit the online VolunTEEN application. Also send in the VolunTEEN Program Guidelines and the Parental Consent Form. Then you do a job shadow. After that, you go to an orientation and an interview. You also do onboarding and health steps.
notes: Adults 18 and older use a different program with 30 hours in three months. The page says the wait from application to first shift is about six weeks for adults. Sturgis, Custer, Lead-Deadwood and Spearfish hospitals have their own volunteer contacts; the page does not say they take teens.
